 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Udai Shankar Singh, Advocate
For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Jitendra Kr. Singh, APP

For the Informant : Mr. Avinash Kumar Pandey, Advocate  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned APP for the State.

2. The petitioners apprehend their arrest in connection with Veldi P.S. Case No. 305 of 2023 for the offence registered under Sections 341, 342, 323, 504, 506, 498A, 313, 316 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act lodged on 20.10.2023 by the informant, Kabita Kumari.
3. Pursuant to the last order dated 01.05.2024, the lady appeared and narrated her ordeal and for the present wants to remain where she is.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.24865 of 2024(3) dt.15-05-2024 4.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submit that she being the legally wedded wife, he intends to pay Rs. 10,000/- per month and for the month of May, 2024, he shall be paying the same by 31st of May, 2024.

Further, from June, 2024 he shall be diligently paying Rs. 10,000/- by tenth of every Shiv Prasad Manjhi vs The State Of Bihar on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98486842/

6. Taking into the account the aforesaid facts/development, this Court is inclined to extend them privilege of anticipatory bail which will be subject to the fact that he shall be diligently paying Rs.
10,000/- to the informant by 10th (tenth) of every month and failure to do so, the informant shall be free to take immediate steps for cancellation of his bail bonds.
7. The amount of May, 2024 shall be paid by 31st of May, 2024.
8. Learned counsel for the informant also undertakes to file a maintenance case before an appropriate Court within six months from today.
Once, the final order in the maintenance Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.24865 of 2024(3) dt.15-05-2024 case comes, this payment order shall merge with the order passed by the concerned Court.
